reason: I work all week, so it would only ever be a Saturday thing, and $15 a visit or $45 a month is a lot when storytime and the parks cost nothing. I'd maybe try the free first visit, but I wouldn't commit to paying.
objection: I only have Saturdays, so unlimited never pays off and $15 a visit adds up fast for something I can get free at the library and parks.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend visit price around $8-10, or a really good reason Saturdays are worth it, like it never being packed when I show up.
